index 0000000..d2bec46
--- /dev/null
+++ b/src/click/option_conflicts.py
@@ -0,0 +1,32 @@
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import collections.abc as cabc
+from collections import Counter
+
+from .parser import _split_opt
+
+
+def find_option_conflicts(options: cabc.Sequence[str]) -> tuple[list[str], bool]:
+    """Find spellings that share a casefolded name after removing the prefix.
+
+    Order conflicts by prefix length, preserving input order for ties. The
+    second result indicates whether any input spelling has a ``/`` prefix.
+    """
+    parsed = []
+    counts: Counter[str] = Counter()
+    has_slash = False
+
+    for option in options:
+        prefix, name = _split_opt(option)
+        name = name.casefold()
+        counts[name] += 1
+        parsed.append((len(prefix), name, option))
+
+        if prefix == "/":
+            has_slash = True
+
+    conflicts = [
+        (length, option) for length, name, option in parsed if counts[name] > 1
+    ]
+    conflicts.sort(key=lambda item: item[0])
+    return [option for _, option in conflicts], has_slash
diff --git a/tests/test_option_conflicts.py b/tests/test_option_conflicts.py
new file mode 100644

+++ b/tests/test_option_conflicts.py
@@ -0,0 +1,18 @@
+import pytest
+
+from click.option_conflicts import find_option_conflicts
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize(
+    ("options", "expected"),
+    [
+        ([], ([], False)),
+        (["-q", "--Q", "--quiet", "--quick"], (["-q", "--Q"], False)),
+        (["--A", "--B", "/b", "-a"], (["/b", "-a", "--A", "--B"], True)),
+        (["--Straße", "+STRASSE"], (["+STRASSE", "--Straße"], False)),
+        (["/unique", "--quiet", "--quick"], ([], True)),
+        (["//q", "//q"], (["//q", "//q"], False)),
+    ],
+)
+def test_find_option_conflicts(options, expected):
+    assert find_option_conflicts(options) == expected
notes:
The helper uses _split_opt to count casefolded names and track exact slash prefixes independently of conflicts. It returns original spellings from groups with multiple entries, stably sorted by prefix length.
